name: Historical or Epigraphical Correction
about: Report an error in character attestation, transcription, dating, or provenance
title: '[EPIGRAPHY] '
labels: epigraphy, research-integrity
assignees: ''
---

**Character or Source Identifier**
- Character ID: (e.g., `PAL-V-001`, `PAL-C-014`)
- Script: (Pallava / Grantha / Vatteluttu / Tamil-Brahmi)
- Historical Source ID: (e.g., `SRC-PANDEY-2018`, `SRC-EI`)

**Nature of Correction**
- [ ] Inscriptional reading / transcription error
- [ ] Erroneous dating or dynastic attribution
- [ ] Confused script tradition (e.g., Pallava conflated with later Grantha)
- [ ] Misattributed or unverified provenance
- [ ] Phonetic value or IPA transcription inaccuracy
- [ ] New primary epigraphical evidence discovered

**Description of Error & Proposed Correction**
A detailed scholarly description of what is incorrect and what the verified evidence indicates.

**Primary Scholarly Evidence & Citations**
Please provide exact citations (Publication, Volume, Year, Plate number, Line number):
- Publication:
- Editor / Author:
- Estampage / Photograph link or archive reference:

**Academic References**
List academic papers or ASI reports supporting this correction.
